not_run.E4: Actual H2 UI + configured model + actual tools semantic recall NOT_RUN

limits: Summaries are deterministic source extracts plus mandatory host work state, not live-model semantic recall.
Candidate activation is atomic in the Agent journal; it is not an atomic transaction with a remote model.
Byte/hash identity is exact; request token costs and pressure remain AR-050 estimates.
Default compaction is bounded: interval 12, minimum 4, pressure 0.65, max 16 cycles; no unlimited work/restart replay claim.
No cancellation preemption is promised after the synchronous summarizer has already started.
